description:
Activate Penance by putting a card from your hand on top of your library, preventing the next instance of damage from a black or red source of your choosing. Repeat for each card you wish to put on top, ensuring Radiant Solar, Preston the Vanisher, and Faceless Butcher will be the creatures encountered by Dack. (Note: if those three are the only creature cards in your library, most likely due to deck construction, you may omit this step.)
Cast Dack Fayden by paying {4}{W}{W}.
When Dack enters, its ETB triggers, putting the three creatures mentioned into play and giving one to each opponent.
Faceless Butcher triggers once, Preston triggers twice, and Radiant Solar triggers three times. Choose Preston as the target for Faceless Butcher.
Resolve Faceless Butcher's trigger, exiling the Preston you gave away until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Faceless Butcher.
The Illusion Faceless Butcher triggers, exiling the original and returning Preston to the battlefield under your control.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Radiant Solar. It triggers, giving you a fourth "venture into the dungeon" trigger.
Resolve three venture triggers, progressing through the Tomb of Annihilation until you reach the Sandfall Cell and losing 3 life in the process (reduced to 1 if you have a card available to discard).
Sacrifice the Illusion Faceless Butcher to the Sandfall Cell, returning the original Faceless Butcher to the battlefield.
Faceless Butcher, Preston, and each Radiant Solar you control all trigger.
Resolve Faceless Butcher's trigger, exiling the nontoken Radiant Solar until it leaves the battlefield.
Resolve Preston's trigger, creating an Illusion copy of Faceless Butcher.
The Illusion Faceless Butcher triggers, exiling the original and returning Radiant Solar to the battlefield.
Preston, the nontoken Radiant Solar, and each Illusion copy of Radiant Solar all trigger.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating an additional Illusion copy of Radiant Solar.
The Illusion of Radiant Solar triggers, giving you an additional "venture into the dungeon" trigger.
Resolve four venture triggers, completing and re-entering the Tomb of Annihilation. Progress to the Sandfall Cell, losing 3 life in the process (reduced to 1 if you have a card available to discard).
Repeat steps 10 through 18. Now that you have more than one token copy of Radiant Solar, each iteration will result in an increasing number of venture triggers in excess of the four needed to perform the loop. 
For each group of four excess venture triggers, you may alternate between the Tomb of Annihilation and the Lost Mine of Phandelver. Due to the Veils of Fear room and the Dark Pool room, this will offset the life loss and discard from the Tomb while accelerating your opponents' life loss.
